# v1.6.0 — Mobile app feature parity

- Expanded the Android app across Projects (create/rename/delete), Boards (create/rename/delete/move), Kanban tasks (create/edit/delete/move, assignee, checklist, complete/reopen), and column management.
- Added checklist completion behavior and UI feedback, including green checked rows and auto-completion when all checklist items are done.
- Added global search and click-through navigation, per-project file upload with image thumbnails and list/grid display, plus open/share actions.
- Added account/server controls, ntfy settings/testing, and admin controls for app name, default columns, and user management.
- Added additive `PATCH`/`DELETE /api/columns/{id}` backend routes for mobile column management.

## Verification

- Verified backend CRUD through the API and built a local release APK; Flutter analysis and tests passed.
